name: Fossilization
text: Target misses actions until end of round. + You may put an Earth or Vitality permanent bonus token on your tile. + Also put a damage-shield Earth token on your tile.

effect.usage: effect animation strip (cols = frames; grid in assets/frames.json), play once at the target hex

fx.usage: sound effect on resolution / impact of the effect

data.text: Target misses actions until end of round. + You may put an Earth or Vitality permanent bonus token on your tile. + Also put a damage-shield Earth token on your tile.

logic.description: Implemented. One enemy in contact loses the remaining actions of this turn (lock rest of turn), and the caster buys an Earth OR Vitality bonus token (stat-pill pick, else the higher of its Matter / Vitality, tie Earth — 1.1.0, user request 2026-11-17) and an Earth damage-shield token on its own tile (user ruling 2026-11-18: a failed token roll no longer voids the cast — the lock and the tokens bought land, the owed token re-emits next action and that retry emission only buys the owed token — no new lock ('do retry, not lock') — even with nobody in reach). Standing on the tile, the bonus token adds to the caster's stat and life maximum; the map shows the tokens as lettered dice plus a building on the hex (a stone guardian statue for Earth, a Healing Orb for Vitality) and the stat pills as +N◆; tokens buff whoever stands on the tile, enemies included (user ruling 2026-11-18). Every peer shows '<Fossilization> success' over a locked target or '<Fossilization> failed' (retry / nobody in reach / Disable / Blessing ∀). Aura / Aura ∀ widen the locked recipients.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
No declared target (the engine picks the enemy the cast hurts most within 1) or the right-clicked target is within 1 hex; through an Aura ∀ the reach is the whole view (10).
A declared target must be an enemy (exactly one side is npc_b); without one the engine aims at an enemy itself.
A declared target must still be alive (life > 0); dead units are skipped.

effects.description: The target loses the remaining actions of this turn (paper: rest of the round).

One bonus token on the caster tile, Earth OR Vitality: the element picked by clicking a stat pill (Vitality, or Matter cycled to Earth), else the one the caster's stat is higher in (tie: Earth). One point-buy on that stat, highest die is the token value; a failed roll keeps the lock and re-emits the last element for this token only (the retry locks nobody again). While anyone (caster, ally or enemy) stands on the tile the token adds to its Matter (Earth) or Vitality stat and to its life maximum (general_ux_hitpoints_calculations).

Damage-shield token(s) on the caster tile for elem_earth: one point-buy each on the caster stat, highest die is the token value; a failed roll keeps the lock and the bonus token and re-emits the last element for the shield only. The shield absorbs the first damage taken on that tile and is spent.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_earth (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.

notes: 1.1.0 (user rulings 2026-11-17/18): Earth OR Vitality bonus token (cast.elem, else the higher stat, tie Earth); a failed token roll keeps the lock and the bought token (status done, kept = token slots [value|null]); the retry emission (cast.kept non-empty) locks nobody ('do retry, not lock'), never fizzles, buys only the owed slots. Mirrors effects.mjs TOKEN_RETRY_KEEPS.
